newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias up 12.5 pct on technical rise.
newsitem.headline: Victorias up 12.5 pct on technical rise.

text.p: Shares in Philippine's biggest sugar miller Victorias Milling Corp rose on Tuesday by 40 centavos, or 12.50 percent, to 3.60 pesos on a technical rebound mingled with hope that its financial troubles can be resolved, brokers said.
"It's not as bad as people thought but the knee-jerk reaction was to sell. Now, people believe the situation can be salvaged," said Allan Araullo of Regina Capital Development Corp.
Victorias was down to 3.20 pesos on Monday from 4.50 pesos on March 6, when news of the company seeking a moratorium on debts of 4.4 billion pesos came out.
A total of 263,000 shares changed hands in mid-session on Tuesday.
